title: Writes to a vendor contact before every gateway certificate renewal.

initial.contacts: Marek Dolan at the certificate vendor.
initial.diagnosis: Check the expiry date and the vendor's pinned fingerprint list.
initial.pitfalls: Renewing before the vendor confirms breaks partner traffic.
initial.rationale: The vendor pins our certificate and has to add the new fingerprint first.
initial.rollback: Re-install the previous certificate while it is still valid.
initial.steps: Mail the vendor a week ahead, wait for confirmation, then renew and roll.
initial.trigger: A gateway certificate renewal is planned.
